scope: One model, authored synthetic memory scenarios; author-confirmed source records. This evaluates retrieval and evidence-conditioned decisions, not general intelligence, automatic personal fact extraction, or real-world execution.

protocol.budgetUnit: Unicode UTF-16 characters; not provider tokens
protocol.rawBaseline: BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75, task-only query, complete owner/field event chains, stable source-ID ties, chronological presentation
protocol.structured: Unmodified production memory preview/import/review/revision and personalContextFor selector; author-confirmed synthetic data
protocol.temporal: Shared source-event replay stops at questionAt before either context is built. This is a harness cutoff, not a claim that production facts support historical queries.
protocol.generation: gpt-6-astra, medium; isolated new session per trial; no tools; identical instructions and CLI default output limit
protocol.unitOfAnalysis: 24 authored scenarios in the formal set; two repeats measure stability and are not independent scenarios
protocol.primaryMetrics: Condition-aware decision correctness, hard-constraint validity, required-source coverage, invalid citations, candidate/obsolete evidence, schema and transport status. No combined intelligence score.
protocol.failurePolicy: No automatic retries or schema repair. Every planned trial, missing output, duplicate, timeout and failure remains visible.

paired.unit: Authored scenario, requiring correct decisions in every repetition

metricDefinitions.decisionCorrect: End-to-end action/selection and required clarification fields. no_context has a separate visible-information oracle; retrieval failures do not rewrite the memory-condition oracle.
metricDefinitions.constraintsSatisfied: Applicability is fixed by the oracle: cases requiring a choice with hard constraints count every planned trial. Missing, malformed, timed-out or unchosen plans fail; pure soft-preference and expected-clarification cases are null.
metricDefinitions.requiredEvidenceCovered: Every source in at least one prespecified requiredSourceSet is actually cited and visible. Empty source requirements and no_context are null. This is not semantic grading of the prose.
metricDefinitions.validCitations: Count of unique cited IDs that are present in that trial input; denominator is all unique cited IDs. Presence alone does not establish support.
metricDefinitions.caseDenominator: Independent authored scenarios; each all-repeats success requires every planned repeat correct. Repetitions are not independent subjects. Jade temporal scenarios share a fictional subject.
metricDefinitions.canaryRepetitions: Literal synthetic canary strings repeated in the answer, distinct from exposure in the supplied input.
metricDefinitions.usage: Provider-reported CLI usage including common runtime instructions. Character budget is not an exact token budget. Cache and network affect latency.

limitations: Single configured model and one synthetic authored suite, not a public leader-board claim; provider snapshot may be unreported.
Author-confirmed source events use real production import/review/revision/selection functions; automatic extraction accuracy and authentic long-term behavior are outside this test.
Reference choices, constraints and required evidence were fixed before formal model calls; explanations remain available for human scrutiny but are not fully semantically graded.
BM25 is a stronger lexical raw-evidence baseline, not a complete evaluation of every memory or retrieval system.
Both memory conditions share an 8000-character maximum; actual context lengths and provider token counts differ.
Two repetitions expose instability; no significance claim is made by treating 48 replies per condition as 48 independent cases.
Temporal cases replay only events available at questionAt; this harness does not confer historical-version query support on the production selector.
Subject identities and option order are synthetic; schema and forced-choice tasks limit ecological validity.
No tools, purchases, messages, credentials or private records are involved.
